answer_sql:
SELECT
  dp.brand,
  SUM(sl.net_amount) AS net_revenue
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS sl
JOIN contoso_served.dim_product AS dp
  ON sl.product_key = dp.product_key
GROUP BY
  dp.brand
ORDER BY
  net_revenue DESC
